mapper.select: SELECT IDX AS idx, ExpendDate AS expendDate, ExpendCode AS expendCode, Cost AS cost, Remark AS remark FROM Expend WHERE IDX = #{idx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Expend ( ExpendDate, ExpendCode, Cost, Remark, InsertDate, InsertUserID ) VALUES ( #{expendDate}, #{expendCode}, #{cost}, #{remark}, GETDATE(), #{insertUserId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE Expend SET ExpendDate = #{expendDate}, ExpendCode = #{expendCode}, Cost = #{cost}, Remark = #{remark}, UpdateDate = GETDATE(), UpdateUserID = #{updateUserId} WHERE IDX = #{idx}
